stages.designIntent: Compact orange juvenile fox with huge ears, warm amber eyes, cream cheek/chest fur, one flame tail, gold spiral markings and orange heart-core gem.

Owner-confirmed Stage 2 form: the same cute orange fox evolves into an upright anthropomorphic fox guardian with fox head, ears, muzzle, hands and feet, a red-and-gold Cyber-Taoist robe, warm yellow-orange crown flame and one large integrated flame tail; heroic without losing fox identity.

Owner-confirmed Stage 3 form: the same orange fox remains an upright anthropomorphic fox luminary with bright cyan eyes, dark navy Cyber-Taoist robe, cyan and restrained magenta circuit trim, cyan-magenta resonance flame crown and one orange-to-cyan flame tail; cute and cool, never an unrelated human or nine-tailed fox.
